title: Jewelry Table
html:
The Jewelry Table, also known as Valuables_Jewelry , is a leveled Treasure Table containing copper, silver and gold jewelry. It drops proportionally more expensive jewelry at higher levels.

Drop table

Average value per level:

Levels Value
